# mux_drm_configurations (Data Source)

Lists the DRM configurations of the environment, for the `drm` playback policy. Mux provisions them; the API cannot create or change one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mux_drm_configurations" "all" {}

resource "mux_live_stream" "protected" {
  title = "Protected channel"
}

resource "mux_live_stream_playback_id" "drm" {
  live_stream_id       = mux_live_stream.protected.id
  policy               = "drm"
  drm_configuration_id = data.mux_drm_configurations.all.ids[0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) IDs of the DRM configurations, in the order Mux lists them. Empty when DRM is not set up.
